TASK-20260908-aecfb9 returns a revised zero-run design for IDEA-20260906-69b3fc, prepared for fresh parent validation and independent protocol review. The initial delivery was returned by actual dispatcher checks for administrative review-chain defects; its seven original byte sequences are preserved in the published initial-delivery gzip. This return supersedes the initial completion assertion for the unpublished producer paths. H-SDEG-96e0d7 is specified and EXP-SDEG-8dfcf9 remains review_required with approved_by:null. DEC-20260908-bc02eb approves only design custody and mandatory independent protocol review. TASK-20260908-bdb28c must review the exact stopped snapshot before implementation; its archive TASK-20260908-6910da and post-review DEC-20260908-071e1a are separate future gates.

The selected source SHA256 is 3b7e7109312bf9e7b9746ae572c1ebf0ed98cc5247ac25604bb6c155f27fa8dd. The design retains p=101,211,431, all summand arities m=2,3,4 and separately labeled generic, j=0 and j=1728 panels. It adds explicit full_curve and target_subgroup companion scopes, with three fixed base seeds. There are 162 registered cells:54 calibration cells in RUN-SDEG-7dd157 and108 held-out cells in RUN-SDEG-74f830. Every target and ordered base tuple is included; the cell populations are exactly |T||V|^m outer tuples and |T||B|^m signed tuples. These are finite set definitions, not fabricated numerical point counts or independent random observations.

For the generic panel A=1 and B is the first nonzero residue giving a nonsingular curve with N!=p+1. Special curves are y²=x³+1 and y²=x³+x. Point sets, N, largest prime factor q, cofactor h, lexicographic prime-order generator G, SHA-ordered factor bases and targets are completely determined by the specification. Any anomalous N=p case is explicitly tagged and separated; it cannot support transfer to non-anomalous curves. The full literal expansion is owned by the authorized calibration record, before solver metrics; implementation and activation freeze only the exact recipe, source bytes and seeds. Calibration retains its preparation operations, time, memory, literal arrays, counts and hashes, and holdout binds those immutable fixtures. Root explicitly chose this allocation to prevent scientific enumeration or numerical S4 tests from being hidden inside a zero-run task.

The proposed special-j classification is a symbolic deduction, not a counted result: j0 is supersingular at101 and431 and ordinary at211; j1728 is ordinary at101 and supersingular at211 and431. To see the criterion, trace modulo p equals the coefficient of X^(p-1) in (X³+AX+B)^((p-1)/2), by the finite-field power sums. The j0 coefficient is present and nonzero exactly when p=1 mod3; the j1728 coefficient is present and nonzero exactly when p=1 mod4. The remaining coefficient is zero. Sutherland's retrieved Theorem13.3/Corollary13.4 identifies trace zero with supersingularity for p>3. The scientific constructor/checker must verify every actual classification and keeps these panels out of the generic-ordinary pool.

The source's explicit proof_search_map.method_ceiling places the twofold complete-cost effect on m=3,4 toy chains. The m=2 rung has no internal elimination and is retained as a full identity/control census, with its costs and H1 statistic reported. The design does not impose or claim a new twofold improvement at that identity rung. Every prime, panel, scope and held-out seed remains in the m3/m4 confirmatory comparison.

The main mathematical completion concerns intermediate identity points. Semaev's retrieved affine-chain converse assumes absence of shorter decompositions; it cannot certify this unrestricted tuple census by itself. Each actual ordered signed tuple instead has a unique first internal prefix equal to O, or none. For m3 the exceptional chart P2=-P1 requires P3=R. For m4 the first-O-at2 chart solves P3+P4=R after P2=-P1; first-O-at3 requires P1+P2=-P3 and P4=R with the previous prefix nonzero. The remaining chart uses rational affine prefix coordinates. Target O has its own final S2 relation, never an artificial x(O)=0. These charts preserve repeated points, inverse pairs, rational two-torsion and all allowed identity contributions.

The exact S3 polynomial, fresh-variable S4/S5 resultant construction, coefficient rings and variable orders are written in the specification. Determinant minors fix S_j and PSC_j, including S0 as the ordinary Sylvester resultant. The basic AFP PRS recurrence is frozen with its scaling and signs. Every division retains a nonzero guard and an exact quotient identity; each zero coefficient branch re-specializes the original equations and restarts with actual degree. All-zero polynomials admit the entire finite coordinate domain. A generic fraction-field quotient is never specialized across a vanishing denominator. The AFP homomorphism lemma requires injectivity, which ordinary parameter specialization lacks.

For m3 the guarded solver finds common rational roots of two specialized polynomials in U. For m4 it constructs an intermediate resultant in W, solves that with the final edge, then recomputes the original specialized gcd in U for every candidate W. Every recovered algebraic witness must lift to coherent rational point signs and reproduce its actual group prefixes. The retained output is a set of ordered point tuples. Separate fields store x-fiber size, univariate gcd root multiplicity and certificate-path count; resultant degree never substitutes for any of them.

A simple hand-derived regression is proposed for the historical substitution collision. On p=101, E:y²=x³+x+1, P=(0,1), doubling gives (76,62) and tripling gives (72,5). Thus the correct S4(0,0,0,72) vanishes. The sequential-substitution mutant instead uses S3(U,72,U), whose value at U=76 is8; its resultant with1-4U is28 mod101. These expected values are a manual design derivation. No arithmetic test was executed here. The authorized calibration record must verify this fixture against fresh-variable construction, the current simultaneous=True implementation and the deliberately faulty mutant.

The comparison uses two complete direct-resultant arms, materialized and outer-specialized, and takes the stricter valid complete cell cost as its reference. One unrestricted branch calls the identical direct algorithm and must reproduce its solution and operation-event stream exactly. A basic F4 algorithm has fixed critical-pair selection, symbolic preprocessing, full monomial columns and exact row operations, with final ideal-containment and S-pair certificates. Exhaustive point decomposition is an independent complete comparator. For subgroup cells, BSGS/rho controls first acquire actual logs from points, then enumerate all decompositions and verify them; their full task matches the guarded solver. Standalone DLP costs are contextual, not substituted for an all-decompositions baseline.

Nine control families are frozen. They include complete matched coefficient chains; a vanishing-leading-coefficient system retaining a true solution; equal zero-resultant/generic-root-count families with different specialized gcd branches; zero/constant/degree-gap systems; all identity masks and sign cases; the S4 collision regression; extension-only roots versus rational multiplicity; and generic relabeling. The collision family's resultant is explicitly the zero polynomial in both cases. The design does not pretend it exhibits equal nonzero-resultant degrees.

All construction, discovery, branch tests, empty and singular paths, root reconstruction, failed attempts, serialization, witnesses and independent checking are charged. Base-field primitives have a fixed meter; inversion charges its binary exponentiation operations. Integer/hash/lookup/byte costs, CPU/wall time and memory are separate. Setup is apportioned by exact signed-tuple weights with sum reconciliation. H1 tests whether at least90% of that weight lies in full structural patterns whose pooled complete cost is at most0.4 reference. The complete cell target is at most0.5 reference work with zero point-tuple mismatches. All SAT/UNSAT, ordinary/special, identity/affine and exceptional rows and worst-decile tails remain separate.

K counts structural patterns over every attempted outer tuple, including terminal-empty outcomes. K_declared also retains unvisited syntactic branches with empty-domain certificates. The reference products D2=1,D3=4,D4=32 and adjacent finite logarithmic ratios are explicitly diagnostic. Three arities cannot establish an asymptotic growth rate. A low K or output degree cannot establish an ECDLP improvement; the full time/memory/data frontier and novelty remain unresolved.

The proof-search map separates local algebraic correctness, guard/chart coverage, rational correspondence, termination/size, full cost/success probability and strict improvement. The prospective formal Executor TASK-20260908-a1f9af targets only L1a, nonzero-multiplier zero preservation under exact evaluation identities, and L2a, disjoint first-zero classification.
